skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concept, importance, and functions of organizational behavior, models of organizational behavior, challenges and opportunities for organizational behavior.
Understand and explain individual factors such as personality, attitudes, perception, learning, motivation, and decision-making.
Understand and explain group factors such as roles, norms, group composition, group size, status, group cohesion, group decision-making, communication, and group leadership.
Understand and explain the factors that influence the selection of organizational structure models.
Recognize organizational culture, its origins, practices to maintain and spread organizational culture, and conditions and methods to change organizational culture.
Analyze the impact of individual and group factors on individual behavior and group effectiveness.
Propose ways to build effective work groups and measures to promote effective individual behavior in organizations.
Analyze the impact of organizational structure models and organizational culture on individual behavior and organizational effectiveness.
Propose the selection of organizational structure models and organizational culture suitable for specific organizations.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and effectively in a team.
Demonstrate the ability to present reports and presentations on organizational behavior issues at various levels.
Demonstrate the ability to analyze, synthesize information, and solve problems related to organizational behavior content.
